title: ai-sdlc.yaml — per-repo declarative pipeline contract
description: Normative schema for the .ai-sdlc.yaml file that every repo opting into the AI-SDLC pipeline places at its root. Versioned (semver-tagged); workflows pin to a spec version.

engine_id.description: Certified adapter identifier (epic #152). `scc` is the sc-agent-cli reference engine; the remaining ids certify through the conformance suite in docs/engine_contract.md. A certified id still needs a config/engine_adapters.json entry before a stage can dispatch to it — the contract certifies names, the registry implements them. Unknown values are rejected here, not at dispatch time.

model.description: Provider-native model id routed to this stage's task class (issue #171; spec/model-routing.md). Wins over `model.primary` for this stage only; OmniRoute route names (auto/*, devin/*) are Hermes control-plane only and resolve to `model.primary` on GHA runners (ADR-0001).

oneOf.description: Stage-definition form: `engine` selects the certified adapter for the stage, `model` overrides the routed model for the stage's task class. At least one is required — a missing `engine` falls back to `engine.name`, a missing `model` to `model.primary`. An object (not a bare id) so per-stage overrides can grow fields without a schema break.

promotion_thresholds.description: Per-target-level promotion thresholds (spec/trust-ladder.md — Thresholds per rung): each field overrides the scalar `promotion.*` default for that target level only. Values below the rung's normative floor are invalid per spec.

clean_runs_threshold.description: Clean completed runs required — the evidence unit for pre-merge rungs (`suggest`, `auto-pr`), which produce no merges yet.

clean_merges_threshold.description: Clean merges required for this target level.

window.description: Window override for this target level; the >=10 minimum evidence base still applies.

spec.description: Spec version this config conforms to (semver, e.g. "1.0.0"). Required — lets the runtime refuse unknown contracts.

repo.description: Repo characterization hints used for policy defaults and routing.

autonomy.description: Trust-ladder ceiling: the pipeline may operate BELOW this level, never above.

merge_requires_checks.description: If true, auto-merge requires all required_checks green even at auto-merge-all. Default: true.

freeze_env.description: Env var name that, when set, freezes autonomy to shadow. Default: AI_SDLC_FREEZE.

promotion.description: Trust-ladder promotion evidence gates (spec/trust-ladder.md): the contract pre-declares the thresholds its run evidence is measured against. Metrics are computed over the rolling window of completed pipeline runs; passing the gate opens a promotion contract PR (issue #211).

clean_merges_threshold.description: Clean merges inside the window required before a promotion proposal is opened.

window.description: Rolling window in completed pipeline runs the promotion evidence is computed over; spec/trust-ladder.md sets 10 as the minimum evidence base.

required_signals.description: Evidence signals the promotion gate requires to report `pass` (spec/trust-ladder.md — The four signal types). Default: all four. `track-record` is mandatory and may never be the only required signal — clean merges alone never earn autonomy.

overrides.description: Per-target-level threshold overrides (spec/trust-ladder.md — Thresholds per rung): keys are the promotable ladder levels; each entry overrides the scalar promotion.* defaults for that target only.

demotion.description: Trust-ladder demotion triggers (spec/trust-ladder.md): breaching a bound drops one level and opens a demotion PR recording which bound was crossed (issue #211).

escalation_threshold.description: needs-human escalations inside the window that trigger a demotion proposal.

window.description: Rolling window in completed pipeline runs demotion evidence is computed over.

priority_label.description: Label applied to demotion PRs triggered by a sentinel halt (spec/trust-ladder.md — Demotion and freeze).

triggers.description: Intake contract: which issues enter the pipeline.

skip_labels.description: Terminal/ignored labels. Recommended: epic, wontfix, invalid, duplicate, question, dependencies, needs-human.

authorized_labelers.description: GitHub logins whose labels trigger dispatch. Empty = anyone.

min_body_length.description: Definition-of-Ready R4 (spec/definition-of-ready.md): minimum issue-body length in characters for a 'non-trivial description'. Default (120) matches ai-sdlc-intake.yml's existing hardcoded floor — making it configurable changes no repo's current behavior until it is overridden.

acceptance_criteria.description: Definition-of-Ready atomicity bounds for the acceptance-criteria checklist (spec/definition-of-ready.md: '1–8 criteria ... >8 probably not atomic').

min.description: Below this many checklist items, DoR R3 treats the issue as not ready. Default (1) matches ai-sdlc-intake.yml's existing hardcoded floor.

max.description: Above this many checklist items, the issue is probably not atomic and should decompose. null (default) = unbounded — ai-sdlc-intake.yml does not enforce a ceiling today, so this field is opt-in; set to 8 to match the DoR-recommended bound.

verify.description: Per-repo verification contract — commands the agent must keep green.

commands.description: Shell commands run in the worktree before a PR is opened (e.g. 'npm test').

required_checks.description: GitHub check-run names that must be green for automerge. Empty = all reported checks.

review.description: Review stage policy (see spec/risk-taxonomy.md when landed).

critical_requires_acceptance.description: pr:risk-critical PRs withhold merge until pr:risk-accepted is applied. Default: true.

max_fix_iterations.description: Bounded review→fix convergence: fix passes pushed to the PR head per pull request before escalating needs-human (issue #28).

max_changed_files.description: Bounded-edit atomic-blast-radius ceiling (ADR-0003 'atomic file limit'): maximum files a single implementation attempt may change before escalating needs-human. null (default) = unbounded — no runtime stage enforces a ceiling today, so this field is opt-in; 5 is a reasonable starting value.

wait_max_minutes.description: Merge-gate cap on waiting for a pending review verdict on the head SHA. Past the cap automerge proceeds and records review_timeout — review infra can never deadlock the pipeline.

external_reviewer.description: Slug prefix of an external reviewer (e.g. 'coderabbit') whose check-run conclusion and pull-request reviews are ingested; its blocking signal outranks the AI verdict. Empty = AI-only path.

skip_labels.description: Labels that block merge unconditionally. Default: needs-human, hold, do-not-merge, wip.

postmortem.description: Canonical postmortem lifecycle knobs (spec/postmortem-lifecycle.md) — signature dedup window and reopen-on-recurrence threshold, consumed by scripts/postmortem.js.

reopen_min.description: Post-close recurrences of a signature required before the closed canonical issue reopens (spec POSTMORTEM_REOPEN_MIN). Below the threshold a recurrence only comments.

dedup_window_days.description: Dedup retention window for closed postmortem issues, measured from closedAt (spec POSTMORTEM_DEDUP_WINDOW_DAYS). Open issues dedup regardless of age.

labels.description: Flow-state label names (scc:* issue flow, pr:* PR states). Keys map canonical states to label names; repos may rename without forking the runtime. `state_machine` is a reserved key holding the issue-label exclusivity/ownership matrix (spec/labels.md).

state_machine.description: Issue-label state machine matrix (spec/labels.md): forbidden co-occurrences + per-label write ownership. Janitors evaluate it on drift; the effective forbidden set also includes every triggers.skip_labels entry vetoing triggers.issue_label.

winner.description: Label that survives when both co-occur (the blocker/run-state).

loser.description: Label stripped by the winner's actor, or by a repairing janitor on drift.

veto_pairs.description: Forbidden label co-occurrences. An observed pair is a pipeline defect: veto + repair + log, never a silent skip.

set_by.description: Actor tokens allowed to apply the label (see spec/labels.md actor vocabulary).

cleared_by.description: Actor tokens allowed to remove the label. `human`, `janitor`, and a veto pair's winning actor are always implicit.

clear_guard.description: Label that must be present before a non-human clears this one (e.g. policy:accepted for a policy-fired needs-human).

owners.description: Label → write-authority map (actor tokens per spec/labels.md).

model.description: Model routing hints consumed by the engine dispatcher.

engine.description: Engine invocation contract (sc-agent-cli today; any tool honoring the headless contract). `name` is the global default engine — per-stage selection lives in `engines`.

engines.description: Per-stage engine and model selection (issues #205, #171; docs/engine_contract.md, spec/model-routing.md): stage → certified adapter and/or stage model. `implement: devin` (shorthand), `implement: {engine: devin}` and `implement: {engine: devin, model: openai/gpt-4o}` are all accepted; the stage-definition form may also carry `model` alone to route a model without pinning the adapter. A stage without an `engine` falls back to `engine.name` (default `scc`); a stage without a `model` falls back to `model.primary`. Unknown stage keys, non-certified engine ids and empty stage definitions are rejected.

notify_channels.description: Free-form notification targets (deployment-specific: discord channel ids, slack webhooks names, etc.)

policy_floor.description: Org-baseline only (spec/org-policy.md): floor fields the org pins so repos cannot relax them, plus per-repo exemptions. Ignored when present in a repo contract.

pin.description: Dotted leaf paths enforced as org floors (e.g. autonomy.level, review.critical_requires_acceptance, merge.skip_labels, triggers.skip_labels, verify.required_checks).

exempt.description: Repos ('owner/repo' or bare repo name) exempt from the org baseline entirely.
